podcast.body: This album was released in the spring of 2000 after a long wait from fans, but by then Britpop had faded, the songs were perceived as lacking, and sales were dismal. The band announced an amicable breakup shortly after. "Finally, a record called The Menace showed up in the spring of 2000."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
